subject: Draft MAP + SOW — final signoff timeline and Day 1 onramp
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@marketwave.com>, MarketWave Procurement <procurement@marketwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + SOW — final signoff timeline and Day 1 onramp

Hi Sara / Team,

Attaching an updated MAP (v3) and the SOW draft for your procurement review. This thread is to lock timing for final approvals and the signature slot so we can hit the proposed Day 1 start window of 2028-01-03. High level asks:

- Please confirm the internal approval lane (legal / procurement / exec) and an estimated ESIGN window (2 business days preferred).
- Let us know any remaining procurement evidence items — I attached our procurement checklist to speed the review.
- If procurement needs a redline, Kimberly (cc'd legal) will pick up and circulate a final SOW ready for DocuSign.

Attachments: [MAP_v3.xlsx (Spreadsheet)], [SOW_draft_20271201.pdf (PDF)], [Procurement_Checklist.docx (Docx)]

Next steps from our side: Rishi will provision a dedicated staging slot for the pilot, and Camila will prepare the onboarding playbook for Day 1. Once you confirm approval lane + signer availability, Naomi will initiate DocuSign.

Proposed timeline (target):
- 2027-12-01: internal approval signoff window identified by MarketWave
- 2027-12-02 to 2027-12-03: SOW redlines completed (if any)
- 2027-12-04: DocuSign out to signature
- 2028-01-03: First-day onboarding kickoff (mutual ramp week 1)

If the proposed start date is aggressive for your resourcing, tell us the latest possible Day 1 window and we'll shift the DocuSign slot accordingly.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-minute call if you prefer to run through the map live.

—
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Sara Li <sara.li@marketwave.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, MarketWave Procurement <procurement@marketwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + SOW — final signoff timeline and Day 1 onramp

Naomi — thanks for the package and the clear timeline. I pulled in procurement because they'll own the formal signature lane. Quick updates from our side: 

1) Approval lane: Procurement -> Legal -> CIO (exec). Procurement has a preferred 48-hour review window; Legal will need at least 24 hours for redlines. CIO signoff is generally quick once Legal clears.
2) Signer: our CFO (Anil Sharma) will be the final signer — he'll likely be available in the afternoon of 2027-12-05.
3) Evidence: procurement needs SOC2 in-scope confirmation (we already have your compliance packet), and they asked for a single-line data retention statement in the SOW (can your legal add this?).

We can commit to a rapid review if Redwood can guarantee: a) final SOW with the single-line retention term and b) a DocuSign request targeted for 2027-12-05 PST. That timing aligns with Anil's availability.

I'll coordinate internally and come back with the exact procurement reviewer names by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

—
Sara Li
Head of Product Ops | MarketWave
sara.li@marketwave.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sara Li <sara.li@marketwave.com>, MarketWave Procurement <procurement@marketwave.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + SOW — final signoff timeline and Day 1 onramp

Thanks for looping me in — drafted a one-line retention clause below that we can slot into the SOW. Naomi, I'm happy to issue a redline now and circulate for Sara's procurement.

Suggested retention statement to insert into SOW (short form):
"Redwood Inference will retain customer-generated inference logs and related operational telemetry for a configurable retention period not exceeding 90 days by default; retention policies can be extended by mutual written agreement."

Action items for legal/proc run:
- I will deliver a redline of SOW_draft_20271201.pdf with the retention statement and minor clarifications on data handling by 2027-12-01 12:00 PST.
- If procurement requests SOC2 artifacts, point them to https://compliance.redwood.ai/soc2 (we will attach the compliance packet to the DocuSign envelope).

Signature timing guidance: DocuSign out on 2027-12-05 morning PT means procurement + legal will have time to complete their reviews internally; final sign-off by CFO in the afternoon is realistic. If MarketWave needs earlier execution, we can compress the window but would require explicit exec backup (alternate signer).

—
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@marketwave.com>, MarketWave Procurement <procurement@marketwave.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + SOW — final signoff timeline and Day 1 onramp

Perfect — thanks Sara and Kim. Summary and final ask:

- Kimberly will produce the redline with the 90-day retention clause and attach SOC2 pointer by 12:00 PST today.
- MarketWave confirms the CFO signing slot on 2027-12-05 afternoon PT; procurement will send final reviewer names by EOD 2027-12-01.
- Once redline is accepted, Naomi will create the DocuSign envelope and target 2027-12-05 09:00 PT send time so we capture the afternoon signer availability.
- Rishi will reserve the dedicated staging GPU pool for go/no-go validation during the week of 2027-12-11; Camila will prepare the Day 1 onboarding checklist and the 3-day ramp playbook.

Attachments (for convenience): MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW_redline_20271201.pdf (to follow from Kimberly), Procurement_Checklist.docx

If MarketWave confirms the 2027-12-05 sign send, we'll mark the deal as "boarding ready" and lock the 2028-01-03 Day 1 in our rollout calendar. I'll send the DocuSign link once Kimberly's redline is cleared.

Thanks everyone — short call if anyone wants to run the signature choreography live in the next hour.

—
